author: reek
body: The 16 GB USB stick carries everything: OS, compiler, source, and optionally a pre-bundled agent model. First boot detects whether an agent is present and offers to set the agent up.

author: reek
body: Discovery answers whether the image carries a bundle at all. It is a presence check and nothing more: an agent is only ever admitted by `Works chapter AgentBundle`, which checks the manifest signature, the model digest and the model format in that order.

author: reek
body: This section used to look for `<root>/agent/manifest.json`, a path nothing in the tree has ever written, so BundledNone was the only answer it could give and the difference between an image with an agent and an image without one was invisible. The name below is the one `build/build-img.ps1` actually writes into the ESP root.

author: reek
body: A package is valid when the bundled-agent chain admits it, and at no other time. This function used to answer PackageValid on a `verified` field that nothing in the tree ever set to True, which made it a function that could report a package verified without any verification having happened. It delegates now, so there is one answer to this question and one place that decides it.
